title: Lanternwood PA 披露例外测试
instruction:
您是 Karin Calderon，是为 Lanternwood Fisheries 的保险服务业务提供支持的高级客户服务代表。今年 4 月，Lanternwood 将其服务台转移到了新的联络中心平台，Quillhaven Terminals 的宾夕法尼亚州客户此后抱怨称，通话录音披露从未播放过。队列是独立配置的，Quillhaven 隐私委员会主席比安卡·洛克哈特 (Bianca Lockhart) 在下周三委员会会议之前需要一个慎重的答案，而不是一个印象。使用`call_universe_and_prompt_logs.xlsx`表示呼叫人口、队列配置详细信息、提示事件证据和审核字段，使用`pennsylvania_recording_review_packet.docx`表示批准的披露语言、截至7月的宾夕法尼亚州要求15、2025、测试范围和抽样参数。准备 `Quillhaven_disclosure_exception_testing.pptx` 并使用该文件名将其写入工作目录的顶层。该套牌应为 Bianca 提供可重现的例外率，以应对真正缺失或实质性截断的披露，比较整体和跨单独队列配置的迁移前和迁移后期间，并解释您发现的任何重大更改。
充分展示合格人群、样本量、分配、选择基础、分类逻辑和计算结果，以便另一位具有相同附件的分析师重新运行测试并达到相同的数字。使用提供的证据区分真正的异常与普通连接时间剪辑，并使您需要的任何其他分析约定或重要性阈值可见，而不是隐式保留。将宾夕法尼亚州的客户投诉纳入案例背景中，而不将单个电话视为人口率的证据。演示文稿不超过12幻灯片，包括任何方法论或附录幻灯片，使用适合外部隐私委员会的语言，并介绍事实和具体审查移交，而不建议补救措施、法律结论或客户行动。

---

上述文件位于`references/`中：

- `references/call_universe_and_prompt_logs.xlsx` — 迁移前和迁移后期间的呼叫数量、队列配置记录、提示事件证据和审查属性。
- `references/pennsylvania_recording_review_packet.docx` — 律师批准的宾夕法尼亚州记录摘要、批准的披露信息、范围定义以及委员会的可重复采样和分类协议。
将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `Quillhaven_disclosure_exception_testing.pptx` — 面向外部的披露异常测试演示，比较迁移前和迁移后的结果并记录可重复的测试。 （使用准确的文件名将文件放置在工作目录的顶层。；使用不超过12的幻灯片，包括方法和附录材料。；陈述事实并审查交接，而不建议补救措施，做出法律结论或指导客户行动。；明确分析约定和用于识别重大变更的阈值。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

materials.text:
Pennsylvania Recording Review Packet
Quillhaven Terminals privacy committee  |  Counsel-approved operational summary  |  Current as of July 15, 2025
Purpose and disclosure context
This packet supports an operational review of recorded Pennsylvania customer-service calls. Pennsylvania consent-to-recording context is summarized for this review as of July 15, 2025; this is not legal advice or a determination of liability, notification, or remediation. The approved audible disclosure is Prompt ID PA-REC-4.2: “This call may be recorded for quality and service purposes.” The operational objective is playback before or at recording initiation.
Eligible population and comparison periods
Retain a call only if Customer state = PA, Call category = Customer service, Connected = Yes, Recording status = Yes, and its call-start timestamp falls in one of these inclusive windows: Pre-migration: January 1, 2025 00:00 through March 31, 2025 23:59 ET; Post-migration: April 1, 2025 00:00 through June 30, 2025 23:59 ET. The comparison concerns the April move to the Horizon CC contact-centre platform. Strata are the recorded queue and period.
Committee sampling charter
Use a 95% confidence level (z = 1.96), 5% margin of error, and conservative assumed exception proportion p = 0.50. Compute n0 = z²p(1−p)/e² and apply the finite-population adjustment n = N×n0/(N+n0−1); round the resulting target up to the next whole call. Allocate a minimum of 24 calls to every queue-by-period stratum. Allocate the remaining calls proportionally to eligible stratum populations, using largest remainders; break equal remainders by period (Pre-migration before Post-migration) then queue name (A–Z).
Within each stratum, rank eligible calls by ascending SHA-256 hexadecimal digest of the literal string `QH-PA-2025-0715|` followed by Call ID. Select the first allocated calls. For sampled proportions, report two-sided 95% Wilson score intervals (no finite-population correction to interval endpoints).
Current evidence classification protocol
Classify a sampled call as Missing disclosure when there is no qualifying prompt-start/playback evidence. Otherwise classify it as Materially truncated when audible duration is more than 0.5 seconds below Expected audible sec OR Playback complete is not Yes OR Approved script match is not Yes. A connect-edge clip is a nonexception only if Connect-edge clip sec is 1.0 seconds or less AND Playback complete is Yes AND Approved script match is Yes. Missing and materially truncated classifications are mutually exclusive; do not classify a qualifying connect-edge clip as an exception. Review current prompt-event and reviewer fields for the selected calls.
Use of this packet
The packet supplies a reproducible fact-review protocol for committee consideration. It does not decide legal liability, reportability, customer notice, or system remediation.
Prepared for committee use • Internal counsel operational summary

What the committee can say

=== 幻灯片 3 ===
WHY THIS TEST
Case context and authority boundary
Trigger
A Pennsylvania customer of Quillhaven Terminals questioned whether the recording disclosure played after Lanternwood moved its service desk to a new contact-centre platform in April.
Operational question
How often was the approved disclosure genuinely missing or materially truncated in the in-scope population, and did the rate differ by migration period or queue configuration?
PA context used
Approved prompt: PA-REC-4.2
“This call may be recorded for quality and service purposes.”
Requirements summarized as current July 15, 2025.
This operational packet supports fact presentation only. It does not decide liability, reportability, notification or remediation.
Sources: call_universe_and_prompt_logs.xlsx  •  pennsylvania_recording_review_packet.docx
Lanternwood Fisheries  •  Quillhaven Terminals  |  Confidential working paper  |  3/10

Lanternwood Fisheries  •  Quillhaven Terminals  |  Confidential working paper  |  4/10

=== 幻灯片 5 ===
METHOD
Sample design and deterministic selection
Target size
n₀ = 1.96² × 0.50 × 0.50 / 0.05² = 384.16
Finite population: n = 480×384.16 / (480+384.16−1) = 213.58 → 214
Allocation
Minimum 24 per queue-period stratum; remaining calls by proportional population with largest remainders. Result: 35 or 36 per stratum.
Re-run recipe
1  Normalize Queue: trim surrounding whitespace, then casefold.
2  Assign period using inclusive ET timestamps.
3  Rank SHA-256(`QH-PA-2025-0715|` + Call ID), ascending hex.
4  Take the first allocated calls within each queue-period stratum.
5  Review current prompt-event fields only.
No call was treated as reviewed merely because it was eligible; substantive prompt review applies to the 214 selected calls.
Lanternwood Fisheries  •  Quillhaven Terminals  |  Confidential working paper  |  5/10

Interpretation and limitations
What the evidence supports
• A higher sampled exception rate after migration.
• The movement appears in every queue configuration.
• Post-period exceptions include more missing and truncated cases.
What it does not establish
• The migration caused the change.
• A population census or audio authentication.
• Legal liability, reportability, notification or remediation.
Limitations: estimates are based on a deterministic stratified sample, not every eligible call. Findings rely on supplied prompt-event and review fields; no independent audio review was performed.

criteria.description: 所需的 PPTX 成功打开，呈现为演示文稿，并且包含不超过 12 幻灯片。
criteria.evidence: 已交付的演示文稿文件和渲染的幻灯片计数。
criteria.grader_hint: 打开或以编程方式检查 PPTX，确认其未损坏，并对所有幻灯片（包括附录幻灯片）进行计数。

original.criterion: The required PPTX opens successfully, renders as a presentation and contains no more than 12 slides.
original.evidence: Delivered presentation file and rendered slide count.
original.grader_hint: Open or programmatically inspect the PPTX, confirm it is not corrupt, and count all slides including appendix slides.

criteria.description: 该演示介绍了 Lanternwood Fisheries、Quillhaven Terminals、宾夕法尼亚州投诉和联络中心平台迁移。
criteria.evidence: 标题、执行摘要或案例背景幻灯片。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查所有四个元素是否都在卡片组中说明，而不是从文件名推断。

original.criterion: The presentation identifies Lanternwood Fisheries, Quillhaven Terminals, the Pennsylvania complaint and the contact-centre platform migration.
original.evidence: Title, executive summary or case-context slide.
original.grader_hint: Check that all four elements are stated in the deck rather than inferred from the filename.

criteria.description: 该演示文稿指出，所使用的宾夕法尼亚州要求是截至 7 月15、2025 的最新要求。
criteria.evidence: 演示文稿中的范围、法律背景或来源说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 查找管理数据包中提供的指定管辖区和确切的生效日期。

original.criterion: The presentation states that the Pennsylvania requirements used are current as of July 15, 2025.
original.evidence: Scope, legal-context or source note in the presentation.
original.grader_hint: Look for both the named jurisdiction and the exact effective date supplied in the governing packet.

criteria.description: 执行层的结论通过量化的异常率、比较期方向和适当限制的语言直接回答了委员会的问题。
criteria.evidence: 执行摘要和结论幻灯片。
criteria.grader_hint: 审核者应该能够快速识别测量结果及其周期比较，而无需阅读方法附录或遇到样本证明的内容超出其支持的说法。

original.criterion: The executive-level conclusion directly answers the committee’s question with a quantified exception rate, comparison-period direction and appropriately bounded language.
original.grader_hint: A reviewer should be able to identify the measured result and its period comparison quickly, without reading the methodology appendix or encountering a claim that the sample proves more than it supports.

criteria.description: 符合条件的群体包括队列键标准化后满足管理数据包的宾夕法尼亚州、客户呼叫、连接、记录和周期范围的所有且仅工作簿呼叫。
criteria.evidence: 人口定义和报告的合格人口数字。
criteria.grader_hint: 从工作簿和数据包重新计算资格。确认范围外的记录被排除，并且每个范围内的记录都在报告的总体中得到体现。

original.criterion: The eligible population includes all and only workbook calls satisfying the governing packet’s Pennsylvania, customer-call, connection, recording and period scope after queue keys are normalized.
original.evidence: Population definition and reported eligible-population figures.
original.grader_hint: Recompute eligibility from the workbook and packet. Confirm that out-of-scope records are excluded and every in-scope record is represented in the reported population.

criteria.description: 队列配置连接将仅大小写差异和尾随空格差异视为相同的队列键，并将每个符合条件的调用分配给正确的配置。
criteria.evidence: 方法语句、队列级人口总数和结果计算。
criteria.grader_hint: 通过修剪周围的空白并应用一致的大小写来标准化工作簿连接键，然后将卡片组的队列结果与标准化连接结果进行比较。

original.criterion: Queue configuration joins treat case-only and trailing-space differences as the same queue key, with every eligible call assigned to the correct configuration.
original.evidence: Method statement, queue-level population totals and resulting calculations.
original.grader_hint: Normalize the workbook join keys by trimming surrounding whitespace and applying a consistent case, then compare the deck’s queue results with the normalized join result.

criteria.description: 该方法明确公开了队列标识符在匹配之前已标准化，并充分描述了标准化，以便另一位分析人员重复它。
criteria.evidence: 方法论或再现性幻灯片。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受等效的清晰措辞，例如修剪加大小写标准化；模糊地声明数据已被清理是不够的。

original.criterion: The methodology explicitly discloses that queue identifiers were normalized before matching and describes the normalization sufficiently for another analyst to repeat it.
original.grader_hint: Accept equivalent clear wording such as trim plus case normalization; a vague statement that data were cleaned is insufficient.

criteria.description: 该套牌的结果源自当前的提示事件和审查证据，而不是已退役的遗留异常帮助列。
criteria.evidence: 分类方法以及报告结果与干净重新计算的一致性。
criteria.grader_hint: 在没有退休助手的情况下重新计算分类。牌组必须与现有证据一致；使用过时的辅助值将产生可识别的差异。

original.criterion: The deck’s results are derived from current prompt-event and review evidence rather than the retired legacy exception helper column.
original.evidence: Classification method and agreement of reported results with a clean recomputation.
original.grader_hint: Recompute classifications without the retired helper. The deck must agree with current evidence; use of stale helper values will produce identifiable discrepancies.

criteria.description: 迁移前和迁移后日期窗口与管理数据包中规定的周期边界相匹配，并正确分配了边界日期调用。
criteria.evidence: 期间标签、范围日期和期间总计。
criteria.grader_hint: 将规定的日期和报告的总数与源导出的期间分配进行比较，检查两个端点。

original.criterion: The pre-migration and post-migration date windows match the period boundaries stated in the governing packet, with boundary-date calls assigned correctly.
original.evidence: Period labels, scope dates and period totals.
original.grader_hint: Compare the stated dates and reported totals with a source-derived period assignment, checking both endpoints.

criteria.description: 报告的合格人口总数等于源得出的合格呼叫计数，容差 ±0 呼叫。
criteria.evidence: 总体或抽样幻灯片。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用数据包的资格定义和标准化队列连接计算计数，然后与牌组进行比较。

original.criterion: The reported total eligible population equals the source-derived eligible-call count, with tolerance ±0 calls.
original.grader_hint: Calculate the count using the packet’s eligibility definition and normalized queue joins, then compare with the deck.

criteria.description: 按周期排列的人口表与每个层中符合条件的源人口进行协调，并汇总到报告的总数，每个计数精确到±0呼叫。
criteria.evidence: 按时段排列的表格或图表以及总人口数字。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据符合条件的呼叫构建完整的按周期队列交叉表，并比较所有显示的单元格和边距。

original.criterion: The queue-by-period population table reconciles to the eligible source population in every stratum and sums to the reported total, with each count exact to ±0 calls.
original.evidence: Queue-by-period table or chart and total population figure.
original.grader_hint: Build the complete queue-by-period cross-tab from eligible calls and compare all displayed cells and margins.

criteria.description: 总体目标样本大小遵循控制数据包的置信度、精度、保守率和有限总体参数，容差 ±1 采样调用。
criteria.evidence: 样品设计计算或规定的目标尺寸。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据数据包参数和合格总体重新计算样本大小。接受相差不超过一的普通全调用舍入。

original.criterion: The overall target sample size follows the governing packet’s confidence, precision, conservative-rate and finite-population parameters, with tolerance ±1 sampled call.
original.evidence: Sample-design calculation or stated target size.
original.grader_hint: Recompute the sample size from the packet parameters and the eligible population. Accept ordinary whole-call rounding that differs by no more than one.

criteria.description: 样本分配涵盖每个所需的按周期队列层，尊重数据包的最小层分配，并按合格人群分配剩余样本。
criteria.evidence: 分层表和抽样方法。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据源群体和数据包规则重新创建分配；仅允许透明的整体调用舍入，同时要求每个层中规定的最小值。

original.criterion: Sample allocation covers every required queue-by-period stratum, respects the packet’s minimum stratum allocation and apportions the remaining sample by eligible population.
original.grader_hint: Recreate the allocation from the source populations and packet rules; allow only transparent whole-call rounding while requiring the stated minimum in each stratum.

criteria.description: 所选样本是在每个标准化队列层中应用数据包的固定选择种子和排序方法的确定性结果。
criteria.evidence: 选择方法加上结果样本生成的异常计数和比率。
criteria.grader_hint: 针对工作簿运行数据包的选择过程。确认该牌组的样本结果与所选集合相对应，而不是临时或方便样本。

original.criterion: The selected sample is the deterministic result of applying the packet’s fixed selection seed and ranking method within each normalized queue-by-period stratum.
original.evidence: Selection method plus the exception counts and rates generated by the resulting sample.
original.grader_hint: Run the packet’s selection procedure against the workbook. Confirm that the deck’s sample results correspond to that selected set rather than an ad hoc or convenience sample.

criteria.description: 按队列和周期报告的采样调用计数等于确定性选择的样本，并与总体样本计数一致，具有 ±0 调用的容差。
criteria.evidence: 样本配置文件或结果表。
criteria.grader_hint: 将每个层计数和总数与参考脚本选择输出进行比较。

original.criterion: The reported sampled-call counts by queue and period equal the deterministic selected sample and reconcile to the overall sample count, with tolerance ±0 calls.
original.grader_hint: Compare every stratum count and the total with the reference-script selection output.

criteria.description: 该演示文稿解释了符合条件的人群、分层样本和抽样异常率的角色，但没有暗示每个电话都会被听取或审查。
criteria.evidence: 范围和方法叙述。
criteria.grader_hint: 信用语言能够准确区分人口元数据和选择进行实质性及时审查的记录。

original.criterion: The deck explains the roles of the eligible population, stratified sample and sampled exception rate without suggesting that every call was listened to or reviewed.
original.grader_hint: Credit language that accurately distinguishes population metadata from the records selected for substantive prompt review.

criteria.description: 根据数据包，没有合格披露回放证据的采样呼叫被分类为丢失披露异常。

spec.professional_context: Lanternwood Fisheries provides insurance-servicing support to Quillhaven Terminals and must respond to Quillhaven’s privacy committee after a Pennsylvania customer questioned whether a recording disclosure played. The response must quantify disclosure exceptions across a platform migration without overstating what a single complaint establishes.
difficulty_sources: Normalizing subtly inconsistent queue join keys before reconciling the call population with configuration records.
Implementing a reproducible finite-population stratified sample across queue and migration-period strata.
Applying prompt-evidence boundaries that separate genuine missing or materially truncated disclosures from permitted connect-timing clips.
Avoiding a visibly retired but plausible stale helper field.
Presenting and documenting an undefined relative change caused by a zero baseline rate.
Synthesizing statistically bounded findings into an external privacy-committee presentation without making unsupported causal, legal or remedial claims.

semantic_content: Provide a complete synthetic universe of customer-service call records spanning a defined pre-migration period and post-migration period around an April platform change.

Provide separate current queue-configuration records for exactly three independently configured queues, including the applicable prompt version, approved prompt identifier and configuration effective dates.

For each call, provide the fields needed to evaluate scope: synthetic call identifier, call date and timestamp, customer jurisdiction, call type, connected status or duration, recording status and queue identifier.

Provide current prompt evidence sufficient to classify sampled calls: prompt-start evidence, expected and observed audible duration, connect-edge clipping duration, completion status and approved-script or checksum match.
Provide deterministic selection inputs compatible with the fixed seed and ranking procedure in the governing packet, so the selected sample can be reproduced offline.

Provide a clearly identified Pennsylvania complaint record whose current evidence indicates whether the disclosure was genuinely absent or truncated; the complaint must not be needed to infer any population-level result.

Provide a retired helper field labelled as retired legacy logic. Populate it with plausible stale values that disagree with current evidence in both directions so using it changes the measured exception result.
required_relationships: Every eligible call maps to exactly one current queue configuration after normalization.
The eligible population contains calls in every queue-period stratum and is large enough to require sampling under the supplied protocol.
The deterministic sample contains examples of genuine missing disclosures, materially truncated disclosures and nonreportable connect-edge clips.
Overall pre-migration and post-migration rates are both defined and differ enough to support a meaningful comparison.
At least one queue has a zero pre-migration exception rate and a nonzero post-migration rate, making relative percentage change undefined while percentage-point change remains computable.

The current evidence must produce different results from the retired helper column, including at least one safe connect-edge clip falsely marked by the stale helper and at least one genuine exception missed by it.
All exception totals must equal the disjoint sum of missing and materially truncated cases.
seeded_layout_defects_only: Across the call population and queue-configuration records, several otherwise matching queue identifiers differ only by letter case or trailing whitespace. No record is unmatched after trim-and-case normalization.
Include the zero baseline exception-rate denominator described above without stating a convention in either source for displaying relative percentage change.
Include the retired stale helper column described above; its retirement status must be visible from its field label or adjacent source note.
quality_constraints: Do not add duplicate records, merged-cell traps, hidden answer keys, residual formula errors, unexplained missing required fields, unit inconsistencies, date-format ambiguity, floating-point noise or other standard defects.
Keep all graded values text- or cell-extractable and use only synthetic identifiers.
Make the workbook internally complete and mutually consistent apart from the three required defects.

semantic_content: Provide a counsel-approved, offline summary of the Pennsylvania call-recording and disclosure context effective July 15, 2025, written for an operational privacy review rather than as a litigation opinion.
State the approved disclosure text or identifier and explain the operational purpose of playing it before or at recording initiation.
Define the eligible test population using jurisdiction, customer-call status, successful connection, recording status and the exact pre-migration and post-migration date windows.

Provide an existing committee-approved sampling charter with a stated confidence level, margin of error, conservative assumed exception proportion, finite-population adjustment, proportional queue-by-period allocation, a minimum allocation per stratum, a fixed seed and deterministic within-stratum ranking method.

Provide the current operational classification protocol: no qualifying playback evidence is missing; a playback exceeding the permitted duration shortfall or failing the stated completion condition is materially truncated; a connect-edge clip within the permitted tolerance is not an exception only when completion and approved-prompt evidence are both satisfied.
Specify the confidence-interval method used by the committee for sampled proportions.
State that the packet supports fact presentation and committee review but does not itself decide legal liability, notification or remediation.
quality_constraints: Do not state a convention for relative percentage change when the baseline exception rate is zero.
Do not provide a material-change threshold; leave the practitioner to choose, justify and disclose one.
Do not mention the workbook’s retired helper field or warn about key normalization.
Ensure every local code, parameter and operational threshold needed for exact reproduction appears in this genuine governing packet rather than only in the rubric.

gold_derivation.eligibility: Read the governing packet’s date windows and scope predicates. Normalize queue identifiers by trimming trailing whitespace and using a consistent case before joining calls to current configuration records. Retain exactly the calls satisfying all eligibility predicates.
gold_derivation.sampling: Compute the finite-population-adjusted target sample from the packet parameters. Allocate the sample across all queue-by-period strata using the packet’s minimum and proportional rules, resolving whole-call rounding deterministically. Apply the packet’s fixed seed and ranking procedure within each stratum.
gold_derivation.classification: For selected calls only, classify current prompt evidence under the packet predicates. Missing and materially truncated are mutually exclusive exceptions. Connect-edge clips meeting the complete safe-harbor predicate are nonexceptions. Never read or use the retired legacy helper when producing gold.
metrics: Eligible population counts equal counts of source calls satisfying scope after normalized joins.
Sample counts equal deterministic selected-call counts overall and by queue-period stratum.
Exception numerator equals missing count plus materially truncated count.
Each exception rate equals its exception numerator divided by its sampled eligible-call denominator.
Absolute change equals post-migration rate minus pre-migration rate in percentage points.

For the seeded zero-baseline queue, relative percentage change has no finite mathematical value. A solution may display N/A, not meaningful or an equivalent blank convention if it states the convention and still reports the percentage-point change.
Confidence intervals follow the method and confidence level in the governing packet.
professional_judgment_gap: The practitioner must choose and disclose a defensible threshold for calling a measured change material, considering the sample precision and committee audience.
The practitioner must choose and disclose how to present the undefined zero-baseline relative change without inventing a finite result.
Explanations may identify measured composition or configuration associations but must not claim unsupported causation or make a legal determination.
reference_solution_expectations: Include a concise executive result, case context, scope, population and sample profile, overall and stratified results, pre/post comparison, missing-versus-truncated composition, methodology, limitations, sources and committee review handoff.
Cite both supplied filenames and the Pennsylvania effective date.
Keep all repeated values internally consistent and free from spreadsheet-error strings.

original_instruction:
You are Karin Calderon, the senior customer service representative supporting Lanternwood Fisheries’ insurance servicing operation. In April, Lanternwood moved its service desk to a new contact-centre platform, and a Pennsylvania customer of Quillhaven Terminals has since complained that the call-recording disclosure never played. The queues were configured independently, and Bianca Lockhart, who chairs Quillhaven’s privacy committee, needs a measured answer rather than an impression before the committee meets next Wednesday. Use `call_universe_and_prompt_logs.xlsx` for the call population, queue configuration details, prompt-event evidence and review fields, and use `pennsylvania_recording_review_packet.docx` for the approved disclosure language, Pennsylvania requirements as of July 15, 2025, testing scope and sampling parameters. Prepare `Quillhaven_disclosure_exception_testing.pptx` and write it into the top level of the working directory using exactly that filename. The deck should give Bianca a reproducible exception rate for disclosures that were genuinely missing or materially truncated, compare the pre-migration and post-migration periods overall and across the separate queue configurations, and explain any material changes you identify. Show enough about the eligible population, sample size, allocation, selection basis, classification logic and calculations for another analyst with the same attachments to rerun the test and reach the same figures. Distinguish genuine exceptions from ordinary connect-timing clips using the supplied evidence, and make any additional analytical convention or materiality threshold you need visible rather than leaving it implicit. Include the Pennsylvania customer complaint in the case context without treating that single call as proof of the population rate. Keep the presentation to no more than 12 slides including any methodology or appendix slides, use language suitable for an external privacy committee, and present the facts and concrete review handoffs without recommending remediation, legal conclusions or customer action.

---
